entities.name: Query pantothenate kinase
observations: 320 aa protein; exact full-length sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt C0Z7P4 from Brevibacillus brevis.
Predicted molecular weight is 36,572 Da and theoretical pI is 6.12.
Contains a PRK/Pantothenate kinase family domain, Pfam PF00485, spanning residues 91-246.
Homologs support pantothenate kinase activity, ATP binding, cytoplasmic localization, and CoA biosynthesis.

entities.name: C0Z7P4
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference pantothenate kinase from Brevibacillus brevis; 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query; exact sequence hash match.
Annotated with EC 2.7.1.33, ATP binding, pantothenate kinase activity, cytoplasmic localization, and coenzyme A biosynthetic process.

entities.name: Pantothenate phosphorylation
observations: (R)-pantothenate + ATP = (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + ADP + H(+). Rhea RHEA:16373; EC 2.7.1.33.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: Pantothenate kinase catalyzes step 1 of the five-step pathway from (R)-pantothenate to coenzyme A.

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: Curated reference proteins are annotated as cytoplasmic; the soluble sequence lacks a transmembrane segment or signal-peptide-like N-terminal export region in the reported evidence.
